support_tier_policy.native_primitive_verified: Only exact recipient/state evidence from preserved native receipts; does not imply autonomous useful play.
support_tier_policy.offline_pipeline: Inspected encoder plus dispatch branch, not native delivery.
support_tier_policy.offline_model: Pure model or policy exists; no native effect implied.
support_tier_policy.missing: Required native action/evidence absent in inspected active seams; no exhaustive absence claim.

top_five_gaps: Recipient- and epoch-bound private channel/roster receivers, including whisper and party/guild delivery.
Useful coordinated group behavior: legal support-skill actions, fresh ally telemetry, roles, regroup and effective heal/buff receipts.
Witness-bound contribution schema and native bridge; recipient identity, damage/heal/buff effect and sequence provenance before scoring.
Private relationship persistence and gossip learned only by actual recipients, not shared score-store/log shortcuts.
Native guild lifecycle/permissions/storage/alliance foundation before configured WoE/PvP/BG objectives.

allowed: Received source/recipient/target identities within actual visibility.
Received damage, successful skill/heal/buff indicator plus observable effect when available.
Agent SELF XP/inventory only; another member reported values remain hearsay.
forbidden: Hidden other-member XP/inventory, server database or full-world presence as bot knowledge.
Global social-store updates or log emission presented as received gossip.
Treating missing observations as dead weight, failed skill, no damage or kill-steal certainty.
Ranking true server damage from hidden/transformed GvG presentation.
